# Simple Todo List v1.0.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2

Release of Simple Todo List for Minecraft 26.1.2.

### Features
- Client-side todo list HUD
- Moveable, scalable, and customizable
- In-game inline editing and task reordering via drag-and-drop
- Support for incremental tasks
- Custom themes and opacity settings
- Mod Menu integration

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1.2
- Fabric Loader >= 0.19.3
- Fabric API
- Java >= 25
